question: Executed under the mandatory practical integer frontier (ONE MNQ target, total C43 + ensemble <= 2 contracts), does the TEST53 ensemble add value to C43 and pass the program gate?
why_mechanism_could_exist: The ensemble earns when C43 is flat/light in MNQ; filling only C43's unused MNQ capacity should reduce overlap with C43 drawdowns (lower combined MaxDD) while keeping part of the independent return.
prior_result_motivating_it: TEST53: +23.7 $/day, all gates but G4 (ret/DD 0.0080 < 0.0085); total MNQ incl. C43 reached 5 (violates the 0/1/2 frontier).
difference_from_failed_families: Portfolio construction only; identical module signals, governor -1000, costs.
falsification: Fails any program gate item, or plateau (governor +-10/20%) / stress turns negative.
execution: at each minute capacity = max(0, 2 - C43 MNQ position); a module signal is taken only if the ensemble count < capacity at its fill minute; if C43 later raises its MNQ so that total > 2, the ensemble does NOT reduce (C43 unchanged; excess recorded as report-only); same governor (-$1,000), costs, overnight rules as TEST53
gate: prog_common.evaluate_module G1..G9; G5 plateau = governor in {-800,-900,-1100,-1200}; G6 = >= 3 of 4 modules positive
